summary: Frontend-only verification of the search-bar alignment CSS fix (@layer components refactor in index.css). Measured computed geometry (padding-left, icon rect vs text-start x, vertical centers) for all 4 search inputs at 1440x900 and 390x844, plus regressions: header search routing, cart persistence across hard reload, and home page rendering. All targeted checks PASS. Only one minor consistency deviation found (hero input height 40px vs 46px elsewhere).

issues: hero-search-input computed height is 40px while header/mobile/filter inputs are 46px — spec asked for consistent ~44-48px height across all four search bars. Icon centering and padding are fine; purely a height consistency nit.
Floating chat widget (bottom-right) overlaps the hero 'Search' submit button, partially covering it. Low severity but can block the click on small screens.

action_items: Optional: bump hero-search-input to py-3 / h-[46px] for height consistency with the other three search bars.
Optional: raise the hero section bottom spacing or lower z-index/offset of the chat widget on mobile so it does not overlap the hero Search button.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css now correctly wraps .btn-*, .input-base, .card-base, .container-app inside @layer components — Tailwind utilities (pl-12/pl-11/pl-10) now override the base px-4 as intended. Verified via computed styles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested search-bar checks passed (8/8 scenarios; 2 cosmetic nits)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Search-bar alignment bug is FIXED and verified. Measured values: header padLeft=48px, icon-to-text gap=17px, vertical offset 0.0px, height 46px; hero padLeft=48px gap=14px offset 0px height 40px; products filter padLeft=40px gap=13px offset 0px height 46px; mobile padLeft=44px gap=13px offset 0px height 46px. Regressions verified: header search Enter -> /products?q=rice renders products-page; cart persists in localStorage key 'ambajogai_cart' across hard reload (badge shows 1); home page renders hero, offers banner (10% off / Free delivery / COD), Shop by Category, 16 product cards, 3 review cards, footer. No console errors, 0 error elements on page.
rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: .input-base was declared outside @layer components, so its @apply px-4 was emitted after the utilities layer and beat pl-12, collapsing the placeholder onto the absolute-positioned icon. Moving the custom classes into @layer components restores correct cascade ordering; verified computed padding-left is now 48px/44px/40px per input.
